title: Groot Night
lines: Groot Night is open until 22 December. Its top prize is the Commodore. Crab #8, Clutch, Crab #31, Munch, Peep and Seqwawa are featured. Half the pulls of their rarity give one of them.
In The Little Raid, Grooter is a new origin. Its hits take armour and ward from what they hit. Chorus is a new class. It gives the party mana every second.

more.head: Fights
points: 20 seconds into a fight, healing and shields get 20% weaker.
From then on, all damage rises 5% each second, up to 50% more.

more.head: Leaving every raid
points: Every raid now has 29 figures at a time. When new ones arrive, the same number leave.
Leaving now: Flint, Toast, Shrub, Reed and Vesta. You can still pull them at the Grove, and buy them in raids with your own figures.
gaz's banner has closed. You can only buy gaz in raids with your own figures, if you pulled gaz.

more.head: New figures
points: Peep (1 acorn, Grooter Slinger) throws its hat at the enemy in reach with the most armour. The hit takes 10 armour and ward off it.
Crab #31 (3 acorns, Crab Chorus) gives its 2 nearest friends 25 mana and shields itself.
Munch (3 acorns, Grooter Fang) bites its target 3 times in 1 second. Each bite takes 6 armour and ward off it.
Clutch (4 acorns, Grooter Bulwark) hatches Hatchlings beside it, up to 3 at a time.
Crab #8 (5 acorns, Crab Sneak) hides in its shell for 1 second. Then it hits the enemy with the least health, and again if that enemy falls.
Crab #8 doesn't take up a place on your board. A second Crab #8 does.
The Commodore (5 acorns, Grooter Chorus) is Groot Night's top prize. He calls up to 3 grooters onto free hexes within 2 of him. Grooters still standing are healed to full instead.
While Groot Night is open, anyone can buy the Commodore in any raid.

more.head: Traits
points: Grooter, with 2, 3 and 4: each hit from a Grooter figure or its summons takes 4, 6 or 8 armour and ward. One enemy loses at most 30, 50 or 80.
Chorus, with 2, 3 and 4: your whole party gains 1, 2 or 3 mana a second. Chorus figures gain 2, 4 or 6.
Twig, Brew and Drizzle are Chorus too.
Crab's top step now needs 7 Crabs, not 5. With 2, a Crab #?? joins. With 4, a Big Crab #??. With 7, a Big Crab #?? and two Crab #??.
Sneak's first hits now do 35% and 60% more, down from 40% and 70%.

more.head: Emblems
points: Four new charms: Grooter Ping (Grooter), Tin Whistle (Chorus), Party Finder (Graid) and False Moustache (Sneak).
A Party Finder holder with no true form gets back up as itself.
Every emblem now also gives 10% more health.
